events.what: Necessary conditions on any friend of 10 (odd perfect square, at least seven distinct prime factors including 5, congruences)
Improved bounds on the 3rd and 4th smallest prime divisors of a hypothetical friend of 10
Further structural/modular constraints and a size inequality for a hypothetical friend of 10
Certified exact-arithmetic search showing any friend of 10 exceeds 10^32, plus mechanical re-derivation of known conditions

judgement.doubts: The bullet is a pure existence question with no quantity to bound. A certified search excluding friends below 10^32 checks finitely many instances (F4); necessary conditions on a hypothetical friend (number of prime factors, prime-divisor bounds) only narrow where a friend could hide and settle no restriction of the question, so they are scope none. The record itself says these results 'narrow where a counterexample could hide'. No surviving event, and nothing resolved pre-snapshot, so open.

corrections.why: F4: the record's own outcome says the work 'narrows where a counterexample could hide' — the 10^32 certified search is finitely many instances of the non-existence claim, and the arXiv necessary conditions on a hypothetical friend bound no quantity of this existence question. Nothing survives step 1, so open.
